name: sdd-workflow
description: Project-local SDD workflow plugin for agent-only planning, implementation and gated shipping.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-only plan/work/ship workflow with proportional gates
interface.longDescription: Workspace-local Codex plugin that exposes the project's SDD workflow as native Codex skills and slash commands, while also declaring project-local docs MCP expectations.
defaultPrompt: Select the next scope or use a brief and scaffold the next change
